run_live_docs_server: run the Python script to start a local live-reload docs server on build/html
build_docs_with_livereload: build sphinx docs with live reload by watching *.rst and *.md source files
test_docs_server: test the live docs server by modifying source files and verifying auto-refresh
refactor_docs_watch: refactor the docs server to watch additional file patterns for rebuild triggers
summarize_docs_script: summarize the live docs server script that uses livereload to auto-rebuild sphinx docs
